I will keep this bean plot low-cost because it is very small, and I cannot tie up cash on one small piece unless I am sure it will pay. I do what worked for me and other women around me, so I will use the seed I can manage, put some compost if I have it, and depend on family work. I own this land, so I do try to feed it, but I will not spend on fertilizer, chemicals, or hired labor for only 0.06 hectares.
